items.title: File Einspruch against the Vollstreckungsbescheid
items.quote: Dafür haben Sie ab der Zustellung zwei Wochen Zeit (Notfrist).
items.computation: The letter states the Vollstreckungsbescheid was formally served (Zustellung) on 23.11.2026 (Monday), as recorded by the server ('Zugestellt am 23.11.2026 (Datum laut Vermerk des Zustellers)'). This is a formal court service, so the period runs from that stated delivery date, not from a deemed-delivery rule. Under § 339 Abs. 1 ZPO (via § 700 Abs. 1 ZPO) the Einspruchsfrist is a Notfrist of two weeks from service. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service (Mon 23 Nov 2026) is not counted; the period starts the next day, 24 Nov 2026. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a two-week period ends on the day of the second week that corresponds by name to the day of service, i.e. the following-but-one Monday: Mon 7 Dec 2026. This falls on a working day (no shift needed under § 222 Abs. 1, 2 ZPO). The objection must reach the Amtsgericht Musterwedding by this date.

warnings: This is a Notfrist (statutory, non-extendable court deadline); the underlying claim is already enforceable in the meantime, so if an objection is intended it should be sent well before 07.12.2026 and ideally by a method that proves timely receipt.

The letter's own date (18.11.2026) is five days before the stated Zustellung date (23.11.2026); this gap is plausible for postal delivery but worth double-checking against the actual envelope/postal marking if the person disputes the delivery date.

The names in the letterhead (e.g. 'Musterwedding', 'Kowalbeispiel', 'Exempel Online-Akademie UG') look like placeholder/sample names rather than a specific real court and creditor — verify the court's actual name, address and phone number independently before relying on or responding to this letter.
No payment deadline or bank account for the Gesamtbetrag (789,45 EUR) is given in the letter; if a payment demand with bank details arrives separately, verify the payee name and IBAN before paying.
